title: Social-Engineer Toolkit (SET)
summary: Open-source social-engineering assessment framework maintained by TrustedSec.
whyThisMatters: SET helped standardize social-engineering testing workflows in penetration-testing environments. Its capabilities should be used only with explicit scope and consent.

sections.overview:
The Social-Engineer Toolkit is an open-source framework for social-engineering assessments.

Project

It is maintained by TrustedSec and its user manual identifies David Kennedy as the author.

The software is used in training and authorized penetration-testing exercises.

Ethics

Because social engineering involves people as well as systems, engagement rules and informed organizational authorization are essential.

timeline.event: Social-Engineer Toolkit (SET) is documented as a security tool.
